name: @absolutejs/agent-exchange-secure-messaging-stores
description: Tenant-scoped atomic memory, Redis, and PostgreSQL receipt stores for Agent Exchange secure messaging.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --root src --sourcemap --target=browser --external @absolutejs/agent-exchange --external @absolutejs/agent-exchange-secure-messaging && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public
